units.source_text: 这是四月初十过后的事。

en.t: This happened after the tenth day of the fourth month.

units.source_text: 明日即将举行贺茂祓禊，三公主派了十二个侍女去帮助斋院办事。

en.t: The Kamo purification rite was to be held the next day, and the Third Princess sent twelve ladies-in-waiting to help with the Saiin's preparations.

units.source_text: 其余身份不甚高贵的青年侍女及女童，都用尽心计缝制衣衫，调度妆饰，准备前去观礼。

en.t: The other young attendants and girls of lesser rank put all their ingenuity into sewing clothes and arranging their finery, preparing to go and watch the ceremony.

units.source_text: 各人都忙着自己的事，三公主室内静悄悄的，这正是人目最少的时候。

en.t: Everyone was busy with her own affairs, and the Third Princess's rooms were silent; it was just the moment when the fewest eyes were about.

units.source_text: 公主的贴身侍女按察君，因为与她常相往来的情夫源中将定要叫她去，她也出门去了。

en.t: The princess's close attendant, Azechi no Kimi, had also gone out because her regular lover, Gen Chujo, had insisted on calling her away.

units.source_text: 此时公主身边只有小侍从一人。

en.t: At that moment only Ko Jiju remained at the princess's side.

units.source_text: 小侍从觉得这是好机会，便放柏木进来，叫他坐在公主寝台东面的座位上。

en.t: Thinking this was a good opportunity, Ko Jiju let Kashiwagi in and seated him at the place east of the princess's bed.

units.source_text: 其实何必如此过分殷勤呢！

en.t: But truly, why did she need to be so excessively obliging?

units.source_text: 公主正在无心无思地睡觉，蒙眬中觉得有个男人在近旁，还道是源氏主君回来了。

en.t: The princess was sleeping without a care, and in her drowsiness, sensing a man nearby, she thought Lord Genji had returned.

units.source_text: 忽然这男人恭恭谨谨地走近来，把公主从寝台上抱了下来。

en.t: Suddenly the man approached with great formality and lifted the princess down from her bed.

units.source_text: 公主还道是着了梦魔，连忙睁开眼睛一看，原来是个素不相识的男人！

en.t: The princess thought she was being visited by a nightmare spirit, but when she hurriedly opened her eyes, she saw that it was a man she had never met.

units.source_text: 这人正在讲些奇离古怪而听不清楚的话。

en.t: He was saying strange, bizarre things that she could not make out clearly.

units.source_text: 公主讨厌而又害怕，连忙叫唤侍女。

en.t: The princess was repulsed and frightened, and she quickly called for her attendants.

units.source_text: 然而近旁无人伺候，并没有人听见唤声而走来看视。

en.t: But no one was serving nearby, and no one heard her call and came to see what was wrong.

units.source_text: 公主吓得浑身发抖，冷汗像水一般流出，那昏昏沉沉的模样，非常可怜而又可爱。

en.t: The princess trembled all over with fear, cold sweat pouring from her like water; in her dazed state she looked deeply pitiable and also lovely.

units.source_text: 柏木对她说道：“我虽微不足数，但也并非何等不肖之徒。

en.t: Kashiwagi said to her, "Though I am of little account, I am not such a worthless man as all that.

units.source_text: 多年以来，不知自量，私心爱慕公主。

en.t: For many years, not knowing my own place, I have secretly loved Your Highness.

units.source_text: 若将此心笼闭胸中，势必朽腐泯灭。

en.t: If I kept this feeling locked inside my breast, it would surely decay and vanish there.

units.source_text: 为此不揣冒昧，曾向朱雀上皇泄露。

en.t: For that reason, presumptuous as it was, I once revealed it to Retired Emperor Suzaku.

units.source_text: 乃蒙上皇垂青，并不斥为不当。

en.t: He was gracious to me and did not reject my feelings as improper.

units.source_text: 私心欢慰，以为好事将成。

en.t: Inwardly I rejoiced and took comfort, thinking that the happy matter might come to pass.

units.source_text: 所可恨者，此身官职低微。

en.t: What was bitter was that my rank and office were too low.

units.source_text: 爱慕之心虽然深于他人，而乘龙之望终于变为泡影。

en.t: Though my love was deeper than anyone else's, my hope of becoming your husband finally dissolved like foam.

units.source_text: 明知事已如此，一切都成绝望。

en.t: I knew that matters had come to this, and everything had turned to despair.

units.source_text: 然而一点痴心，从此深藏胸底。

en.t: And yet that one foolish attachment remained hidden deep in my heart from then on.

units.source_text: 年月积累愈久，愈觉可惜可恨，可贪可恋。

en.t: As the years piled up, it seemed ever more regrettable and bitter, ever more desirable and beloved.

units.source_text: 思慕之心，越久越深，今已忍无可忍，不得不越礼求见。

en.t: My longing grew deeper with time, and now I can no longer endure it; I had no choice but to overstep propriety and seek to see you.

units.source_text: 自知此举荒唐可耻，但决不敢更犯深重之罪。”

en.t: I know this act is absurd and shameful, but I would never dare commit any still graver offense."

units.source_text: 三公主听他诉说之时，渐渐明白此人原来是柏木。

en.t: As the Third Princess listened to his confession, she gradually realized that this man was Kashiwagi.

units.source_text: 她非常吃惊，又感到恐惧，一句话也回答不出。

en.t: She was terribly startled and frightened, and could not answer a single word.

units.source_text: 柏木又说：“你害怕么，原也是难怪的。

en.t: Kashiwagi went on, "Are you afraid? That is only natural.

units.source_text: 然而此等事例，世间并非没有。

en.t: And yet such cases are not unknown in the world.

units.source_text: 你倘过分冷酷无情，教我怨气难消，深恐反而轻举妄动。

en.t: If you are too cold and heartless, leaving my resentment unresolved, I fear I may instead act rashly.

units.source_text: 至少你总得对我说一句怜惜的话，那么我就心满意足地告辞了。”

en.t: At least say one word of pity to me, and then I will take my leave fully satisfied."

units.source_text: 他诉说了种种苦衷。

en.t: He poured out all sorts of grievances and distress.

units.source_text: 在事前，柏木预想三公主定然庄重严肃，教人不敢亲近。

en.t: Beforehand, Kashiwagi had imagined that the Third Princess must be dignified and solemn, someone who made others afraid to approach.

units.source_text: 所以他虽去求见，也只指望略诉衷情，立即退去，不敢妄想色情之事。

en.t: So although he had gone to seek an audience, he had only hoped to speak briefly of his feelings and withdraw at once, not daring to imagine any sexual encounter.

units.source_text: 岂知见面之后，觉得其人并无高不可攀之相，却很驯顺可爱，无限温柔的色相中，含有尊贵的娇艳之感。

en.t: But once he met her, he found that she did not seem impossibly remote; instead she was gentle and lovable, with a noble, alluring charm within her boundless softness.

units.source_text: 这正是与常人不同的美点。

en.t: This was precisely the beauty that set her apart from ordinary people.

units.source_text: 柏木便失却了自制之心，他竟想带了她逃到天涯海角，自己的官也不要做了，从此双双偕隐，与世长遗。

en.t: Kashiwagi lost his self-control and even thought of taking her away to the ends of the earth, abandoning his office, and living hidden together with her forever apart from the world.

units.source_text: 于是身不由主了。

en.t: Thus he was no longer master of himself.
